pages.title: Read the situation

pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: Someone must have been here
paragraphs: Fictional flat record: spare key used at 5 pm; receipt printed at 5:20 pm, owner unknown; window currently closed; plant has moved. A neighbour had permission to water plants. No forced entry has been confirmed. Current observations do not establish every earlier event.

pages.title: The first clues
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Someone must have been here. The plant has been moved
lines.audioText: Someone must have been here. The plant has been moved.
lines.translation: Alguém deve ter estado aqui. Mudaram a planta de lugar

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Maybe, but let’s check the record before deciding who it was
lines.audioText: Maybe, but let’s check the record before deciding who it was.
lines.translation: Talvez, mas vamos conferir o registro antes de decidir quem foi

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: A spare key was used at five. There’s also a receipt from five twenty
lines.audioText: A spare key was used at five. There’s also a receipt from five twenty.
lines.translation: Usaram uma chave reserva às cinco. Também tem um recibo das cinco e vinte

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That suggests a visit, but the receipt might have been left by someone else earlier
lines.audioText: That suggests a visit, but the receipt might have been left by someone else earlier.
lines.translation: Isso sugere uma visita, mas o recibo pode ter sido deixado antes por outra pessoa

questions.prompt: What first makes Kim think someone visited?
What does the key record show?
questions.answer: The record shows the spare key was used at five

questions.prompt: Does the receipt prove who visited?
questions.answer: No, the receipt might have been left earlier by someone else

pages.title: What the clues don’t prove
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Could someone have come through the window?
lines.audioText: Could someone have come through the window?
lines.translation: Alguém poderia ter entrado pela janela?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: It’s closed now. That doesn’t prove it was closed the whole afternoon
lines.audioText: It’s closed now. That doesn’t prove it was closed the whole afternoon.
lines.translation: Ela está fechada agora. Isso não prova que ficou fechada a tarde inteira

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good point. We shouldn’t treat a current state as a complete history
lines.audioText: Good point. We shouldn’t treat a current state as a complete history.
lines.translation: Bem lembrado. Não devemos tratar o estado atual como toda a história

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Who had permission to use the key?
lines.audioText: Who had permission to use the key?
lines.translation: Quem tinha autorização para usar a chave?

questions.prompt: What possible entry route does Kim suggest?
questions.answer: Kim suggests someone could have come through the window

questions.prompt: What do they actually know about the window?
questions.answer: They know the window is closed now

questions.prompt: Why doesn’t that settle the question?
questions.answer: Its current state doesn’t prove it was closed all afternoon

pages.title: Choose a useful check
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: The neighbour was going to water the plants, but I don’t know whether she came
lines.audioText: The neighbour was going to water the plants, but I don’t know whether she came.
lines.translation: A vizinha ia regar as plantas, mas não sei se veio

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Then I’d ask her first. The camera record could be another check if needed
lines.audioText: Then I’d ask her first. The camera record could be another check if needed.
lines.translation: Então eu perguntaria primeiro a ela. O registro da câmera seria outra verificação, se necessário

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So our strongest explanation is a permitted visit, not a confirmed identity yet
lines.audioText: So our strongest explanation is a permitted visit, not a confirmed identity yet.
lines.translation: Então a explicação mais forte é uma visita autorizada, mas sem identidade confirmada

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Exactly. We can update that conclusion when we have more than a clue
lines.audioText: Exactly. We can update that conclusion when we have more than a clue.
lines.translation: Exatamente. Podemos atualizar a conclusão quando tivermos mais do que uma pista

pages.title: Find the most plausible explanation
pages.instruction: Give an explanation and say what evidence would confirm it

pages.title: A visit is confirmed
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. The neighbour has confirmed that she used the spare key at five to water the plants. She says she moved the plant away from the closed window before leaving. That supports the explanation of an authorised visit. She doesn’t recognise the receipt from five twenty, though, so we still don’t know who left it or when it came into the flat. Could you update the explanation without making the receipt fit by inventing another visit? We have confirmation for the key and the plant, but only an unresolved clue for the receipt
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. The neighbour has confirmed that she used the spare key at five to water the plants. She says she moved the plant away from the closed window before leaving. That supports the explanation of an authorised visit. She doesn’t recognise the receipt from five twenty, though, so we still don’t know who left it or when it came into the flat. Could you update the explanation without making the receipt fit by inventing another visit? We have confirmation for the key and the plant, but only an unresolved clue for the receipt.
